title: I found 10k GitHub repositories distributing Trojan malware
summary: Security researcher discovered approximately 10,000 GitHub repositories actively distributing Trojan malware, representing a significant supply chain attack campaign. The research involved analyzing repository patterns, malware signatures, and distribution methods to identify this large-scale threat operation on GitHub's platform.
problem_solved: Identifies and exposes a massive malware distribution network operating through GitHub repositories, helping the security community understand the scale of supply chain attacks.
why_valuable: Critical security research that protects developers from supply chain attacks by revealing the scope of malicious repositories and helping establish better detection and prevention mechanisms.
